title: Faith
definition: Faith is trusting, receiving, and resting in God and His promises, especially trusting in Jesus Christ and His finished work for salvation.
summary: Saving faith is more than awareness of facts; it is personal reliance upon Christ. Faith looks away from self and rests in who Christ is and what He has done.
christFocus: The object of saving faith is Christ Himself, especially Christ crucified and risen. Faith does not save because it is strong; faith saves because Christ is sufficient.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Faith includes knowledge, assent, and trust.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Faith receives Christ rather than earning salvation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Faith continues in daily dependence on Christ through the power of the Spirit.
